note:
Final pass on the FAQ jar stack. gpt-image already solved MATRIXYL - correct on both candidates, first attempt, including the fine ingredient line that no Seedream candidate got all evening. It then broke the pink jar, which Seedream had right: 'PDRN COLLAGEIN REPAIR' on _0 and 'PDRN COLLAGEEN REPAR' on _1.

So this takes the gpt-image frame as its own reference and corrects only the pink jar, and it runs across every supplier per rule 1 rather than assuming gpt-image is the right engine twice in a row. Seedream is included precisely because PDRN is the word it renders reliably - the whole lesson of tonight is that the failure modes do not overlap, so the engine that fixes this is probably not the engine that fixed the last one.

The navy jar and the pale blue jar are already correct and stay exactly as they are. Spell it with the letters P D R N, then COLLAGEN with the letters C O L L A G E N, then REPAIR with the letters R E P A I R. Beneath it keep 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' and 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and the fine line 'PDRN | COLLAGEN | COPPER PEPTIDE | 50ML'. Print no word anywhere that is not stated here.
